name: Thora Stoneshield
equipment: A trophy taken from a fallen enemy (a duergar helm, dented)
features: Dwarven Resilience (advantage on saves vs. poison, resistance to poison damage)
Dwarven Combat Training (proficient with battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, warhammer)
Dwarven Armor Training (proficient with light and medium armor)
Stonecunning (double proficiency on History checks related to stonework)
Dwarven Speed (speed not reduced by heavy armor)
Divine Sense (detect celestials, fiends, undead within 60 ft, 3/long rest)
Lay on Hands (pool of 15 HP, heal or cure disease/poison for 5 HP)
Fighting Style: Defense (+1 AC while wearing armor)
Divine Smite (expend spell slot on hit for 2d8+ radiant damage)
Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon (add CHA mod to attack rolls for 1 minute, 1/short rest)
Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy (turn fiends and undead within 30 ft, 1/short rest)
Military Rank (Soldier feature: soldiers recognize your authority)

personality.traits: I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path to success. I can stare down a demon without flinching.
personality.ideals: Greater Good. Our lot is to lay down our lives in defense of others, as the Anvil-Father teaches.
personality.bonds: My clan's ancestral hold, Stoneshield Hall, was overrun by duergar and mind flayers a decade ago. I will reclaim it or die trying.
personality.flaws: My sense of duty is absolute and sometimes blinds me to nuance. I judge others by their actions, not their words, and I hold grudges carved in stone.

appearance: A stocky, powerfully built dwarf woman standing 4'4" with weathered brown skin and iron-grey hair worn in two thick braids bound with copper wire. Her ice-blue eyes are fierce and direct beneath heavy brows. A jagged scar crosses her nose, and her calloused hands speak of years swinging a warhammer. She wears well-maintained chain mail bearing the anvil of Vundar, and her shield — the Stoneshield — is a battered heirloom passed down through her clan for generations.
backstory: Thora served as a captain in the Stoneshield Hall garrison, defending the ancestral dwarven hold against the constant threats of the Underdark. When a combined force of duergar and mind flayer thralls overwhelmed the defenses, Thora led the evacuation, saving hundreds of civilians but losing the hold itself. She took the sacred oath of Vundar — the Oath of Devotion — swearing to protect the innocent and reclaim what was lost. She has spent the last decade gathering intelligence about the Underdark's threats, training relentlessly, and searching for allies strong enough to help her mount a counter-offensive. The expedition into the Underdark is her best chance to understand the enemy and find a path back to her ancestral home.
